# chainlink

<!-- badges: start -->
[![R universe version](https://aqlt.r-universe.dev/badges/chainlink)](https://aqlt.r-universe.dev/chainlink)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/AQLT/chainlink/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/AQLT/chainlink/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

`chainlink` derives price and volume measures of national accounts, following
chapter 8 of the IMF [*Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2017
Edition)*](https://doi.org/10.5089/9781475589870.069):

- Laspeyres-type, Paasche-type and Fisher-type volume indices from current prices
  and price indices (`cp_pi2vol()`, `laspeyres()`, `paasche()`, `fisher()`), and
  conversion of price indices: over the previous period (`pi_py2pp()`), annual
  (`pi_annual()`), values at the average prices of the year (`cp_pi2cy()`);
- chain-linking of quarterly or monthly volume indices with the annual overlap
  and the one-quarter overlap techniques (`chain_link()`, `chain_laspeyres()`,
  `annual_chain()`);
- exact contributions to percent change of chain-linked volume measures, over the
  previous period, over the same period of the previous year or for the annual
  growth (`chain_contrib()`), and contributions to percent change of Fisher
  indices (`fisher_contrib()`);
- non-additivity of chain-linked series (`chain_discrepancy()`), change of the
  reference year (`chain_rebase()`) and pseudo chain series for variables that
  change sign (`chain_pseudo()`);
- un-chaining and aggregation of chain-linked series, for the indirect seasonal
  adjustment of Laspeyres-type series (`chain_unchain()`, `chain_aggregate()`),
  following the [ESS Guidelines on Seasonal
  Adjustment](https://doi.org/10.2785/317290).

All the functions use `ts` objects. The benchmarking of the quarterly series on
annual data is not implemented: use for example the
[`tempdisagg`](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=tempdisagg) package (see the
vignette `imf_qna_manual`).

## Installation


To install the developpment version:

- From [r-universe](https://aqlt.r-universe.dev/fable.rjd3):

```{r, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
install.packages("chainlink", repos = c("https://aqlt.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

- From [GitHub](https://github.com/AQLT/chainlink):

```{r, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("AQLT/chainlink")
```

## Example

The data of the example 8.2 of the manual are two products, `A` and `B`, with
current prices (`imf_cp`) and price indices over the previous year
(`imf_pi`):

```{r example}
library(chainlink)
imf_cp
```

Chain-linked Laspeyres-type volume measures of the products and of the total,
with the annual overlap technique and 2010 as reference year:

```{r chain}
x <- chain_laspeyres(imf_cp, imf_pi, method = "ao", base_year = 2010,
                     output = "measure")
round(x, 1)
```

Contributions of the products to the quarter-to-quarter growth of the total, and
the non-additivity residual:

```{r contrib}
round(chain_contrib(x, imf_cp, method = "ao", extra = c("total", "residual")), 3)
```

Contributions to the growth over the same quarter of the previous year:

```{r contrib-yoy}
round(chain_contrib(x, imf_cp, method = "ao", type = "yoy"), 3)
```

## Vignettes

- `vignette("imf_qna_manual")` reproduces the examples of the chapter 8 of the
  manual and gives the correspondence between the examples and the functions;
- `vignette("contributions")` details the contributions to percent change;
- `vignette("practical_case")` follows a complete workflow, from raw quarterly data to
  chain-linked series and contributions to growth.
